question: What additional attainments and foundational teaching complete the list of Kaula powers, O fair-faced one?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate various Kaula powers and transformations.
The eight attainments are included in this culmination.
The attainment of powers is joined with the root Kaula.
inference: The culmination of the enumerated Kaula powers includes the eight attainments together with the attainment of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the eight attainments is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: And the eight attainments, along with the attainment of the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
